summary: NASCAR 官方赛车游戏，2026 年 9 月 17 日上市（Steam 商店页日期）。开发者披露本作使用 AI 生成了部分 VO 台词与贯穿界面的其他呈现元素。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商与发行商同为 iRacing.com Motorsport Simulations, LLC）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 214），首页有 1 个标题含 AI 的主题（“AI doesnt avoid wrecks or slow down if something is in front of them”），已逐帖读取原文：内容抱怨赛道上对手车辆的行车 AI 不会避让事故车，属游戏内对手 AI 的玩法反馈，与商店披露所指的生成式 AI 无关，按无关主题登记，不改变任何领域结论。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（Steam AI Filter 本作页逐字复刻商店披露，属转录，不构成独立核实）；另读取开发者官网新闻稿 1 篇原文，其内容只公布预告片、预购与玩法特性，文中的 “better driver AI” 指游戏内对手 AI，全文没有生成式 AI 或披露相关内容，因此登记为已读但不作为任何领域证据。其余结果为本作商店页、社区中心页、YouTube 玩家短评与读不到正文的 Reddit 帖。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
description: iRacing 工作室操刀的 NASCAR 官方新作：四个全国系列赛、生涯与全新 The Chase 模式，赛道与车辆沿用 iRacing 的激光扫描资产。

english.summary: The official NASCAR video game by iRacing Studios, released on Sep 17, 2026 according to the store page. The developer states that AI generated certain VO lines and other presentation elements throughout the user interface.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer and publisher iRacing.com Motorsport Simulations, LLC) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 214), where one topic has AI in its title; it was opened and read in full. The post complains that the opponent cars on track do not avoid wrecks or slow down, which is about the in-game driving AI rather than generative AI, so it is logged as unrelated and changes no area finding. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 1 raw source was read: a Steam AI Filter page reproducing the store disclosure verbatim, a transcription rather than independent verification. The official iRacing press release was also fetched and read in full, but it covers the trailer, pre-orders and gameplay features only, its better driver AI wording refers to opponent behaviour and it says nothing about generative AI content, so it is logged without being used as evidence for any area. The remaining results were the store page, the community hub, a YouTube player review and a Reddit thread that returned no readable body. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit.
